shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a blue shirt sits in the pinboard-side aisle seat and asks to hear the full account of the puzzling event from the beginning, while a woman in a yellow shirt sits in the entrance-side aisle seat, a man in a purple shirt sits in the pinboard-side window seat, and a man in a red shirt sits in the entrance-side window seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the entrance end, looking along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the pinboard in frame.

shots.content: The woman in a yellow shirt leaves her seat and exits the venue, while the man in a blue shirt asks about the written details of the account.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt summarizes the main facts of the narrative.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the window side, centered on the person at the pinboard-side aisle seat.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt asks for corroborating evidence, and the man in a red shirt explains the findings.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the worktable.
